description:
Summary:

Add thread-local error storage to the AOTI shim layer so exception
messages survive the C ABI boundary. Custom op errors thrown during
proxy_executor calls were wrapped as generic "AOTInductorModel run
failed with input spec" messages.

- Thread-local `last_error_msg` in shim_common.cpp stores the last
  exception message from `AOTI_TORCH_CONVERT_EXCEPTION_TO_ERROR_CODE`.
- Getter/setter declared in utils.h (internal to libtorch, not part of
  the stable C ABI in shim.h).
- model_container_runner.cpp and AOTInductorModelImpl.cpp read it via
  `get_last_error()` to propagate the original error.
- cpp_wrapper_cpu.py wraps proxy_executor calls in
  `AOTI_TORCH_ERROR_CODE_CHECK` so errors are not silently ignored.

Test Plan:
1. `buck run fbcode//mode/opt fbcode//caffe2/torch/fb/operators:assert_tensor_test`
2. `buck run fbcode//mode/opt fbcode//caffe2/test/inductor:test_aot_inductor -- --regex=test_proxy_executor_error_message_preserved`

Differential Revision: D101574736
